name: Facet
text: Use a single high-contrast dark theme with a persistent one-click toggle to light mode. This keeps the interface clean and focused, matching the Manus Competitive Analysis and Graphify Dashboard’s proven readability. The toggle respects user preference without cluttering the screen. Trade-off: light mode users get a stark contrast shift, but the toggle keeps the switch instant and reversible.

name: Pane
text: The one-click toggle assumes users will tolerate switching modes—some won’t, and the interface will still feel fragmented. A better alternative: default to dark mode but let users *set* their preference permanently, not toggle it. Settle it with A/B testing: measure user satisfaction and task completion time between toggle vs. persistent preference.
